The stack trace is an environment-specific DPI edge case — we haven't been able to reproduce it on stock per-monitor DPI setups. A lot of the DPI-related plumbing was reworked on `main` after the build that produced this crash.

Could you upgrade to the [latest nightly](https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/releases/tag/nightly) and let us know if it still fires? If so, please include the OS DPI settings (display scale percentages per monitor) so we can match your configuration.
